name: Atlantis (STS-36)
about: Atlantis (STS-36) (1990-019A), a crewed vehicle (OV-104), launched 1990 Feb 28. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1990 Mar  2), held fixed
GCAT names the site (EAFB RW23); its coordinates are written from memory
